core_meaning.primary_meaning: Niam is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Blessings, favours”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Niam corresponds to the Arabic form نِعَم (Arabic root ن ع م (n-ʿ-m); نِعَم (Niʿam)). Its core sense is niam; blessing, favour. Niam is Arabic نِعَم (Niʿam) 'blessings, favours', the plural of نِعْمَة (niʿma), from the root ن ع م (n-ʿ-m). The source gloss 'Grace, beauty' is broadly consistent.
